corrections.text: The article states the April 2025 New York event where the Skullcandy-Bose partnership was unveiled was one that Skullcandy 'brand ambassador and sound lab consultant Tony Hawk was in attendance' for, citing Popular Science. That quote is actually a photo caption in Popular Science's article describing the July 15, 2026 Crusher 1080 ANC launch event (the subject of this article), not the April 2025 event. The caption's full text also reads 'Tony Hawk was in attendance, in spirit and likeness,' indicating a symbolic/imagery presence rather than confirmed physical attendance. Popular Science does not report on Tony Hawk's attendance at the April 2025 event.
